title: RPS — Actual vs Predicted by Handler

panels.title: RPS by Handler: Actual (Solid) vs Predicted (Dash, +2.5m ahead)

targets.query: from(bucket: "${INFLUXDB_BUCKET}") |> range(start: v.timeRangeStart) |> filter(fn: (r) => r._measurement == "rps") |> filter(fn: (r) => r._field == "value") |> filter(fn: (r) => r.type == "actual") |> aggregateWindow(every: v.windowPeriod, fn: mean, createEmpty: false) |> map(fn: (r) => ({ r with _field: r.handler + " (actual)" }))

from(bucket: "${INFLUXDB_BUCKET}") |> range(start: v.timeRangeStart, stop: v.timeRangeStop) |> filter(fn: (r) => r._measurement == "rps") |> filter(fn: (r) => r._field == "value") |> filter(fn: (r) => r.type == "predicted" and r.horizon == "150s") |> aggregateWindow(every: v.windowPeriod, fn: mean, createEmpty: false) |> map(fn: (r) => ({ r with _field: r.handler + " (predicted)" }))

from(bucket: "${INFLUXDB_BUCKET}") |> range(start: -24h) |> filter(fn: (r) => r._measurement == "rps_error") |> filter(fn: (r) => r._field == "value") |> filter(fn: (r) => r.handler == "/accounts/") |> last()

from(bucket: "${INFLUXDB_BUCKET}") |> range(start: -24h) |> filter(fn: (r) => r._measurement == "rps_error") |> filter(fn: (r) => r._field == "value") |> filter(fn: (r) => r.handler == "/users/") |> last()

from(bucket: "${INFLUXDB_BUCKET}") |> range(start: -24h) |> filter(fn: (r) => r._measurement == "rps_error") |> filter(fn: (r) => r._field == "value") |> filter(fn: (r) => r.handler == "/transfers/") |> last()

targets.query: from(bucket: "${INFLUXDB_BUCKET}") |> range(start: v.timeRangeStart) |> filter(fn: (r) => r._measurement == "rps_error") |> filter(fn: (r) => r._field == "value") |> aggregateWindow(every: v.windowPeriod, fn: mean, createEmpty: false) |> map(fn: (r) => ({ r with _field: r.handler }))
